title: ivf app-data envelope
description: Common wrapper of every JSON file the app reads (ADR 0001 D1). File schemas $ref this and narrow `dataset` and `payload`. Shared definitions live in $defs. Dates and times are constrained by `pattern`, not `format`: `format` is annotation-only in 2020-12 and Ajv strict mode rejects it without the ajv-formats plugin. Patterns use [0-9] because Python's \d also matches non-ASCII digits. Every pattern ends in $(?!\n) because Python's re lets $ match before a final newline and ECMA-262 does not; with the guard both engines agree (amended M0).

schema_version.description: Semver of the whole contract. Major is pinned to 1 here, so a MAJOR bump means editing this pattern deliberately.

source_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the producing code.

source_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at export.

data_mode.description: Closed enum: adding a value is a MAJOR bump.

dataset.description: File identity; each file schema narrows it with const.

isoDate.description: Session date YYYY-MM-DD (exchange-local, no time zone).

period.description: Closed enum: dev = origin < holdout_start, holdout = origin >= holdout_start.

index.description: 0-based index into an axis array of the same file.

nullablePositive.description: Vol-point level or forecast; must be > 0 when present (QLIKE needs positive values).
